notes: 9 web searches ran, none refused. Identity confirmed: Zack Mullock, two-term Democratic mayor of Cape May, won the 2 June 2026 NJ-2 primary and beat Rep. Jeff Van Drew on 3 November 2026 (WHYY, New Jersey Globe, Inquirer results coverage). Campaign site https://mullockforcongress.com/ and its issues page https://mullockforcongress.com/issues (read 2026-11-14) contain nothing on AI, technology, data centers or China; issues include Economy & Jobs, Healthcare, Housing, Veterans, Environment & Climate (solar and renewable energy). iVoterGuide questionnaire (https://ivoterguide.com/candidate/94523/race/33265/election/1478): no AI answers; China question 'Did not answer'. Paraphrase only, left out of statements: a search-tool summary of a news result (apparently a States Newsroom / New Jersey Monitor article, https://www.newsfromthestates.com/node/434617, which returned HTTP 403 and could not be opened) said Mullock 'would support a moratorium on data center development until policymakers can learn more about their impacts' and opposes tax breaks for developers. Not verified at source and not about catastrophic risk; if the reviewer can confirm it and counts data-center policy as 'about AI', the grade could be D instead of none. As a non-member he could not co-sponsor the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act and did not sign the House letters. Ballotpedia page returned no content.
